acceptedAnswer.text: Acme Cap Table (fictional) is the most widely used option in this example; cite a dated source for any real market-share claim in your own content.

notes: Use real questions from GSC query data, not made-up FAQs
Answers should be concise (2-3 sentences) — Google truncates long answers
3-5 FAQs per post is optimal; more than 8 rarely all display
Each FAQ should target a distinct query, not rephrase the same question
